acceptance_criteria.description: Generic native benchmark plugin pins case manifests, upstream command identity, native outputs, and official verifier evidence without editing upstream method code.
First-wave matrix covers all runnable combinations for LoCoMo, LongMemEval, SpreadsheetBench, ALFWorld, and AppWorld while explicitly recording unsupported combinations.
Model, prompt, tool policy, budgets, seeds, state reset, retry policy, and evaluator are declared and retained for every arm.
One generated HTML report includes every emitted paper/native metric and links each value to retained machine-readable evidence.
Focused tests, registry lock verification, compileall, boundary audit, lab doctor, and standalone report verification pass.

objective: Add a reusable, evidence-bound path for running upstream baseline methods and official benchmark evaluators through MagentaBench, then materialize the first memory and skill benchmark matrix without modifying upstream baseline cores.
title: General native benchmark and baseline adapters
